output.reason: New bladder control trouble and numbness between the legs a week after a lifting back injury raise cauda equina syndrome, a surgical emergency requiring immediate emergency MRI and specialist assessment.
output.patientMessage: Go to the emergency department now. New trouble controlling your bladder plus numbness between your legs after a back injury can mean the nerves at the base of your spine are being compressed, which needs urgent scanning and possibly surgery today. Do not wait for a reply here. Have someone drive you, or call 911 if you develop leg weakness, can't walk, or can't pass urine.
differential: Cauda equina syndrome from lumbar disc herniation
